scope: Add bounded malformed MATERIAL OBJECTS-body recovery and CLI disposition controls for the legacy revisions admitted by the synthetic writer profile.

source.kind: scratch-only DWGs authored at test runtime by the in-tree DWG writer; the valid typed seed is converted to a raw mutated frame and injected with matching custom-class registration
source.object: MATERIAL with a generated name and description; one bounded body bit is flipped after the common prologue has been independently validated.

implementation.controls: Each mutated source reads successfully with one object parse failure, zero entity parse failures, one failed object frame, exact source-frame accounting, and the following LINE callback. Strict ASCII/Binary conversion preserves the destination sentinel. Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion succeeds and reopens with the retained LINE and VPORT. Both revisions exercise the same 2007 output target because the synthetic writer profile admits only AC1015 and AC1018 MATERIAL bodies.

results.outputQualification: AC1015 and AC1018 pass strict refusal plus explicit-partial ASCII/Binary readback. Other source revisions are not tested for this family because the writer enforces source-bound modern MATERIAL profiles.

validation.directControl: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --partial-read-only: PASS; 172 base strict/partial/readback controls, 28 controls each for VBA_PROJECT, GROUP, DICTIONARY, TV_DEVICE_PROPERTIES, POINTPATH, PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX, CURVEPATH, PLOTSETTINGS, and UNDERLAYDEFINITION; 15 BLOCKREPRESENTATION_DATA controls; 18 controls each for VX_CONTROL and VX_TABLE_RECORD; 10 MATERIAL controls

limitations: Generated parser-recovery and CLI disposition evidence only; it does not establish MATERIAL field semantics, producer prevalence, or interoperability.
Only AC1015 and AC1018 generated profiles are covered. Modern MATERIAL writing is limited to exact source-bound profiles and is not exercised by this synthetic source helper.
MATERIAL's current typed parser does not decode the full modern material body; successful raw replay behavior is not qualified by this malformed-body receipt.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
